title: Telephone Encounter and Triage Routing Log
brief: A morning telephone encounter log and message routing note drafted by a medical secretary for incoming patient calls at an outpatient internal medicine clinic.

# Telephone Encounter and Triage Routing Log
Oakridge Internal Medicine Associates

## Call Information
- Date: 10/14/2026
- Time: 09:18 AM
- Caller: Evelyn Brooks (spouse of patient)
- Patient Name: Arthur Brooks
- DOB: 04/12/1958
- MRN: 440912
- Provider: Dr. Marcus Vance, MD

## Provider On-Call Schedule
| Provider | Role | Status | Coverage Assignment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dr. Marcus Vance | Attending Physician | In Outpatient Clinic | Exam Rooms 1-4 until 12:00 PM |
| Dr. Sonia Patel | Attending Physician | Off-site / CME | No clinical coverage |
| Rachel Adams, RN | Telephone Triage | Active | Line 2 routing |
| Jason Ortiz, CMA | Clinical Assistant | In Procedure Suite | Dr. Vance assistant |

## Call Summary
Spouse called stating patient is experiencing worsening productive cough with yellow sputum for 3 days and measured a home temperature of 101.4 °F this morning. Patient denies chest pain, shortness of breath, or hemoptysis. Current daily medications include lisinopril 20 mg PO daily and atorvastatin 40 mg PO at bedtime.

## Action Taken and Routing
- Advised caller that symptom description requires clinical review and that an appointment or prescription may be indicated.
- Transferred caller directly to Dr. Sonia Patel for immediate same-day evaluation.
- Notified triage RN via internal secure chat regarding patient fever and respiratory symptoms.
- Verified primary callback contact number for patient return call:
- Log completed by: Tyler Vance, Administrative Assistant
